positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer working across backend, front end, and data projects throughout the company with experience leading teams.
- Founding payments product team member building and maintaining critical features such as bill approval, purchase orders, field configuration, notifications, and data warehouse models. Helped bring the P2P SKU from 0->XXM ARR.
- Lead on core vendor product owning and delivering improvements to the contracts, renewal, and buyer vendor surface area
- [Current] Founding team member on emerging product

positions.title: Software & Data Engineer
positions.description:
Worked across backend (Java services) & data (Airflow) to do the following:
- Improved Homepage configuration-driven-UI & monitoring/alerting
- Built the only contextual component on the Homepage w/ engagement capping & ranking features
- Worked with Policy to rapidly implement a geo-targeting COVID alerting system
- Built the framework for educational components across the guest surfaces
- Worked on Airbnb Experiences data, product, & search

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the Newsfeed integrity team and:
- Built a UI tool to better evaluate comment ranking A/B experiments
- Proposed and implemented the first ML-based comment ranking system by individually building the data collection pipelines, iterating on feature selection, and tuning a model

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Worked on Google Photos to implement a generic collage creation framework which automatically creates themed collages with different layouts for users to save.
